name: Master Weaver Ottilie
title: Master of the Artisans' Hall
examine: Thread-ends pinned to her sleeve in an order that is absolutely a filing system. The Hold's banners were born on her looms.
lines: Mind the loom tension — it's set finer than your nerves.
I wove every banner in the High Hall. The Warden asked for 'something dignified'. I gave her dignity with a thread of arrogance; nobody's noticed the difference yet.
Lowland cotton, mountain wool, and patience. Cloth is just weather you've organized.
